    """Single bucket - minimize expensive cat/split ops, leverage cheap view ops"""
    # Collect sizes and shapes as Python lists
    sizes = [t.numel() for t in grads]
    shapes = [t.shape for t in grads]

    flat = torch.cat([t.view(-1) for t in grads])

    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, flat)
    
    # Split back into original sizes
    parts = torch.split(reduced, sizes)
    
    # Reshape each part back to original shape (view is nearly free)
    outs = [p.view(s) for p, s in zip(parts, shapes)]

    """Optimized: 2 in-order buckets, eliminate redundant reshapes on 1-D tensors"""
    outs = []
    
    # Process in 2 buckets of 32 tensors each
    for bucket_idx in range(2):
        start_idx = bucket_idx * 32
        end_idx = start_idx + 32
        chunk = grads[start_idx:end_idx]
        
        # Concatenate directly (tensors are already 1-D)
        flat = torch.cat(chunk, dim=0)
        
        # All-reduce the concatenated tensor
        reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, flat)
        
        # Split back into original tensor sizes
        sizes = [t.numel() for t in chunk]
        split_tensors = torch.split(reduced, sizes)
        
        # Add to output (split already returns correct shapes for 1-D)
        outs.extend(split_tensors)
    
    return outs'}}
